answer.evidence: The gate is drawn entirely as a flat architectural front elevation (2D side-view style). Both the top and bottom rails are rendered as rounded-corner panels facing the viewer flat-on, with flat vertical bars between them. Neither the horizontal beams nor the frame display any foreshortened top surfaces seen from a 3/4 high-angle perspective.

The gate is drawn as a flat 2D architectural/platformer front elevation. Both horizontal frame bars have rounded pill-shaped corners facing the screen rather than showing foreshortened top surfaces seen from a 45-degree overhead angle.

The gate is drawn in pure front elevation with horizontal top and bottom panels and vertical bars. Neither the upper rail nor the lower base beam shows a foreshortened top surface viewed from a 3/4 high angle; both panels are rendered as flat frontal shapes with rounded corners.

The gate is drawn strictly in front elevation. Both horizontal beams and the vertical bars show only their flat vertical faces with 2D rounded corners, lacking any foreshortened top surfaces visible from the 3/4 camera angle.
